implementation.name: original-v4-10-latch-force-budget
implementation.scope: Original linear-spring/rigid-arm force plot and exact chapter profile. Braked and unbraked curves are alternative trajectories on one time axis; qualification and uncertainty are outside this model. An amplified spring glyph shows compression tied to the exact plotted force.
implementation.question: Why size the stop from force at brake onset?

purpose: Make response-time compression and continuing compression during deceleration visible over the original force curves.
guard: 39 N is force at physical brake onset, not the end-of-stop peak. Preserve the original curve and axes; no certification or surplus force-margin claim.
